steps: 1. Equip Kruber's Mace and Shield and open Tweaker: Cosmetics customization.
2. Select **The Blood-Bloomed Bouclier**. Confirm it appears once, then inspect its shield name, shield flavor text, and shield icon.
3. Close and reopen customization three times. Swap away and back, enter an Adventure mission, return to the Keep, and inspect the same shield presentation again.
4. Repeat once with a dual weapon whose offhand has its own name or flavor text.
5. Run `/cos_regression_test`, exit the game, and attach the newest log.
assertions: Each independently selected shield or offhand has exactly one selectable row and keeps its own name, flavor text, and icon; the primary weapon's text and icon never replace it. The selection and presentation survive reopen, swap, and Keep to mission to Keep. `issue641_independent_offhand_names` passes and the log contains no duplicate-component failure. If this solo stage passes, peer Hold-Tab presentation can be assessed separately before any co-op label is added.
Call the live item UI-information hook for shield and dual-offhand selections; assert name, description, icon keys are component-owned; pools hold no duplicate semantic identity.
